title: Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful Algerian-inspired lamb kebab recipe with a zesty twist, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim excess fat

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend (or Moroccan spice blend)

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, Algerian spice blend, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the lamb and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Brush the kebabs with the remaining marinade and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
8. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
9. Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
10. Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
